cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(rebaze_fixture C)
enable_testing()
set(DEP_SOURCES dep.c)
add_library(dep STATIC ${DEP_SOURCES})
set(DEP_SOURCES should_not_be_used.c)
target_include_directories(dep PUBLIC include)
set(PROBE_SOURCE main.c)
set(CHILD_SOURCE scope.c)
add_subdirectory(tests)
add_executable(probe ${PROBE_SOURCE})
target_link_libraries(probe PRIVATE Fixture::dep scope)
